title: Spirit Codex
landing: Welcome, keeper. This book grows with your camp: it explains every drum, totem and machine in the order you are likely to meet them.
New here? Open **Getting Started** and read it front to back. It walks you from an empty field to a camp that powers itself, one short page at a time.
Looking for something specific? Type in the search box above. Any item you see on a page can be clicked to jump to the page about it; right-click opens it in JEI if you have it.
Pages about places and creatures you have not found yet stay hidden until you choose to reveal them, so the March keeps a few surprises.
